from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single judgment document."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the judgment document")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The specific cause of action or crime charge stated in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Parses the current document being processed."""
    documents: list[DocumentInfo]
